study: Endogenous stopping boundaries, surrogate learning, and actual owner work
family_scope: The transfer comparison evaluates frozen policies on new contexts. It does not execute inner/outer meta-learning or joint fitting of drift, noise, and cancellation parameters.

math.contract: Analytic single and renewal stopping, implicit derivatives, moving barriers, and global verification inequalities
math.evidence_level: mathematical and numerical correctness, not neural efficacy

learning.contract: Causal sequential evidence, equal-information comparators, three boundary methods by two surrogate gradients
learning.evidence_level: bounded synthetic learning experiment, not natural task or hardware qualification

owner.contract: Versioned readout, original owner and runtime, actual stopping, durable replay, and complete work accounting
owner.evidence_level: original owner in a scoped local research host, not full daemon or learned end-to-end SNN deployment

semantics.spike_amplitude: Binary physical event; task payoff is separately specified
semantics.lambda: Independent cancellation hazard with stated recovery; never silently reinterpreted as energy price or reset rate
semantics.resource_price: Separate price on waiting and execution costs
semantics.smooth_fit: A condition on eligible continuous optimal-value boundaries; not forced on hitting probabilities or discrete owner epochs
semantics.finite_owner_oracle: Bermudan finite-state MDP with explicitly exported transition law
semantics.hit_probability: Finite-window probability without pure utility discount
semantics.terminal_probability: Different event from first passage; existing terminal call/put studies are unchanged

contrasts: free minus fixed within each surrogate
free minus direct within each surrogate
first passage minus standard within each boundary family
neural free-boundary minus same-information raw-belief DP
secondary_factorial_analysis.inference: Descriptive paired seed intervals only; no additional confirmatory claims or test-based selection

acceptance.math: Independent references, whole-domain inequalities, and full-resolve parameter derivatives agree within registered numerical tolerances
acceptance.learning_execution: All six arms and registered seeds execute, source/phase identities match, outcomes and work are independently auditable
acceptance.learning_superiority: Separate predeclared statistical comparison; execution success alone cannot satisfy this criterion
acceptance.owner_execution: Actual owner receipts establish applied decisions, stopping removes later work, and all original-kernel executions and added work are counted
acceptance.production: No production admission or permission expansion is requested by this study
